scope: only/sole/last/full-service grocery closure, fire, or disaster
canceled or suspended emergency food distributions from storm, flood, fire, outage, or facility damage
abrupt pantry or food-bank closure or major access reduction
official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
coverage_notes.result: No new qualifying U.S. food-access disruption was identified in the bounded prior-hour window.
exclusions: Kauaʻi Hurricane Lowell recovery update published 2026-09-29 04:00 PDT reported emergency food distributions continuing as scheduled, not canceled or suspended.
Other surfaced grocery, pantry, food-bank, SNAP/WIC, and storm-related items were stale, outside the prior-hour window, non-U.S., or did not meet the qualifying disruption criteria.
